name: ChapterBlocks
description:
1. User reported that chapter blocks' copy action (copying a section's underlying markdown) was missing on many headings.
2. Root cause traced to `parseChapter()` in `src/utils/markdownParser.js`: only headings with `level + 1` became chapters, while level-skipping headings were flattened into parent markdown and rendered by `MarkdownViewer` (no copy menu).
3. Fix: treat **any** deeper heading as a child chapter, so every heading renders as a `ChapterBlock` and inherits the Edit / Copy / Create-task menu.
4. Only one file changed — `src/utils/markdownParser.js` (`parseChapter()`) — keeping `collectAllChildContent()` and code-fence protection intact.
5. Optional follow-up proposed: render `ChapterMenu` on `:focus-within` instead of hover-only, so keyboard users can reach the copy action.
